functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Opposite action to its superior counterpart (depression vs. elevation); together the two serratus posterior muscles form a functionally opposed pair analogous to (though anatomically unrelated to) internal intercostals' two parts.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: High-frequency linear probe in the sagittal plane over the lower posterolateral thoracic wall, around ribs 9-12, lateral to the lumbar paraspinal muscle mass (the mirror-image location, at the opposite end of the thorax, to the serratus posterior superior block).
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Local anesthetic is deposited between this muscle and the underlying external intercostal muscles/ribs -- directly deep to this muscle's own belly.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Thin muscle sheet seen deep to latissimus dorsi at the thoracolumbar junction, running obliquely upward from the lower ribs toward the upper lumbar/lower thoracic spinous processes.
structures_at_risk: pleura and underlying lung (pneumothorax), deep to the lower ribs at this level
kidney, which lies deep and slightly caudal at the lowest levels of this muscle's extent
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Genuine, muscle-specific finding: the serratus posterior inferior intercostal plane block is a real, named ultrasound-guided technique targeting the plane directly deep to this muscle, reported as case-level clinical experience (post-hysterectomy analgesia; compared against posterior quadratus lumborum block for laparoscopic nephrectomy in a broader 'serratus intercostal plane block' trial). Evidence is thinner than for the serratus posterior superior version of the block -- mostly case reports rather than a dedicated cadaveric anatomy study -- so this is reported as a real but less-established technique. No motor-point/neural-arborization mapping for BoNT injection into this muscle was found.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Karbancioglu Canturk F et al (2025) 'Serratus posterior inferior intercostal plane block for post-hysterectomy analgesia in a patient with multiple analgesic contraindications', Minerva Anestesiol 91(10):977-978, doi:10.23736/S0375-9393.25.19059-7; Fernandez Martin MT et al (2025) 'Intercostal serratus plane block versus posterior quadratus lumborum block in laparoscopic nephrectomy', Rev Esp Anestesiol Reanim 72(6):501728, doi:10.1016/j.redare.2025.501728 -- comparative clinical trial of the related serratus/intercostal plane block approach
